name: Tempo Flow
install: export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"; export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"; if ! command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ "$(bun --version)" != "1.3.9" ]; then curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash -s bun-v1.3.9; fi; sudo ln -sf "$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bun" /usr/local/bin/bun 2>/dev/null || true; bun install --frozen-lockfile && bash .cursor/cloud-agent-install.sh

terminals.name: convex
terminals.description: Convex dev backend. Reads CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT and CONVEX_AGENT_MODE by name. This environment sets no values.

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: Next.js dev server for apps/web. Reads NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL by name. This environment sets no value.

terminals.name: mobile
terminals.description: Expo web for apps/mobile. Reads EXPO_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL by name. This environment sets no value.
